The '''Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport''' was the main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and it served as the headquarters of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Aves (general)|Aves]] and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] until the Republic was able to break out of the sector and push the offensive in other areas of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].
